title: Tōkai Power Station
geometryBasis: Named OpenStreetMap feature 104120199 identifies the original main building, fixes its four exterior corners and gives the alignment of the historic public profile.
sectionBasis: The exact Department of Energy aerial archive photograph shows the stand-alone original station before the second unit and establishes its stacked rectangular massing, rowed industrial hall facade and red-and-white chimney. Japan Atomic Power records the opening in July 1966. The Nuclear Regulation Authority describes the historic 89 m chimney before it was shortened.
limitations: The archival photograph is undated. The selected January 1967 viewing date represents the early standalone appearance after the July 1966 opening. The viewing range ends before construction of the neighboring second station.

The named main envelope and historic chimney height are documented. Chimney and annex placement, roof heights, clerestories and the silhouette of the long hall are interpreted from the public aerial photograph. This edition covers the historic exterior buildings.
